figures.title: Test PR-AUC Comparison Across Representations
figures.interpretation: Evaluates precision-recall AUC across raw and enriched representations. Highlights positive gains on Max for LR and Mean for RF, alongside degradation on unnormalized Sum.

figures.title: Test ROC-AUC Comparison Across Representations
figures.interpretation: Evaluates area under ROC curve across representations. Demonstrates compression of ROC-AUC in class-imbalanced regimes due to large true negative support.

figures.title: Precision–Recall Curve Availability & Protocol Notice
figures.interpretation: Explains that continuous PR curves are omitted in accordance with scientific integrity safeguards because per-example continuous score vectors are not stored in the canonical summary artifact.

figures.title: Test Confusion Matrices at Validation-Selected Thresholds
figures.interpretation: Visualizes true/predicted classification counts for key models (LR raw, LR max, RF raw, RF mean) under frozen validation-optimal decision thresholds.

figures.title: Fraud Detection Operating Trade-off Comparison
figures.interpretation: Illustrates trade-offs between precision, recall, and false alert volume when transitioning from raw tabular features to graph-enriched representations.

figures.title: Computational Timing Profile & Hardware Boundary Qualification
figures.interpretation: Breaks down CPU feature enrichment, model fitting, and scoring latency while explicitly separating host Python process boundaries from isolated CUDA GPU kernel execution times.

figures.title: Context-Policy Sensitivity Analysis
figures.interpretation: Quantifies empirical sensitivity of test PR-AUC when restricting neighbor context strictly to historical training transactions across a 15-day validation buffer.
